blocks.text: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan: narsaning o'zi emas, unga qarash

Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 67–68-darslar): sanaladigan (countable) ot **a / an** va ko'plik `-s` oladi (**a contract**, three **contracts**), sanalmaydigan (uncountable) ot esa ikkalasini ham olmaydi va birlik fe'li bilan keladi (**electricity is** expensive). Bu darsda savol boshqacha: ingliz tili narsani **qanday ko'radi**? Bitta so'z bir gapda dona-dona, boshqasida butun massa yoki umumiy tushuncha sifatida ko'rilishi mumkin — va artikl, ko'plik, miqdor so'zlari shunga qarab o'zgaradi.

Mantiq oddiy. Narsaning aniq chegarasi bo'lsa va uni bo'lganingizda bo'lagi endi o'sha narsa bo'lmasa — u sanaladi: yarim stul stul emas, demak **a chair**. Bo'lagi ham o'sha narsa bo'lib qolsa — sanalmaydi: bir qoshiq asal ham asal, demak **honey**. Mavhum tushunchalar (patience, safety, health) ham shu guruhda: ularni dona qilib sanab bo'lmaydi. O'zbekchada bu farq grammatikada deyarli ko'rinmaydi, shuning uchun inglizcha gap tuzishda har safar o'zingizdan so'rang: bu ot shu gapda sanaladimi?

Bu ingliz grammatikasining eng qat'iy qoidalaridan biri: birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldida aniqlovchi so'z bo'lishi shart — **a / an**, **the**, **my**, **this**, **every** va hokazo. «I need new laptop», «She is writing report» — xato. Sanalmaydigan ot esa artiklsiz bemalol turadi: We need **electricity**. Ko'plik ham artiklsiz turishi mumkin: We need **laptops**. Bu qoidaning tafsilotlari — 71-darsda.

items.text: Our office needs **a new printer**, but there's no **money** for it this year.
items.translation: Ofisimizga **yangi printer** kerak, lekin bu yil unga **pul** yo'q.

items.text: **Electricity** is getting more expensive, and so is **gas**.
Madina has **two jobs** and very little **free time**.
items.translation: Madinaning **ikkita ishi** bor, **bo'sh vaqti** esa juda kam.

blocks.text: Miqdor so'zlari: many / much, fewer / less

Ot turi faqat artiklni emas, miqdor so'zini ham belgilaydi. Sanaladigan ko'plik bilan — **many**, **few**, **a few**, **fewer**, **several**, **a number of**; sanalmaydigan bilan — **much**, **little**, **a little**, **less**, **an amount of**, **a great deal of**. **a lot of**, **plenty of**, **some**, **any**, **no** — ikkalasi bilan ham ishlaydi. O'zbekchada «ko'p» va «kam» bitta so'z bo'lgani uchun xato aynan shu yerda ko'p: «ko'p muammo» — **many problems**, «ko'p vaqt» — **much time** (darak gapda tabiiyrog'i — **a lot of time**). Batafsil — 87-dars.

Og'zaki nutqda **less people** ham eshitiladi, lekin imtihon va rasmiy matnda faqat **fewer people** to'g'ri hisoblanadi. Teskari xato esa umuman yo'q: «fewer money» deyilmaydi. **much** darak gapda rasmiyroq eshitiladi: We've got **a lot of** time (oddiy nutq) — We have **much** time (kitobiy, kam ishlatiladi).

items.text: There are **fewer cars** in the centre since the new metro line opened.
items.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi ochilgandan beri markazda **mashinalar kamroq**.

items.text: I spend **less time** on my phone than I used to.
**How many** hours a week do you study, and **how much** sleep do you get?

blocks.text: Ko'p otlar ikkala turda ham ishlatiladi, va bu tasodif emas. Sanaladigan shakl — **alohida, chegaralangan narsa yoki hodisa**; sanalmaydigan shakl — **modda, material yoki umumiy tushuncha**. Qizil kitobda **a chicken / chicken**, **a paper / paper**, **a glass / glass** juftlarini ko'rgan edik (→ qizil kitob, 68-dars). B1–B2 darajada bunday juftlar ancha ko'p, va o'zbekchada ular ko'pincha butunlay boshqa so'z bilan tarjima qilinadi: **a light** — chiroq, **light** — yorug'lik; **a room** — xona, **room** — bo'sh joy.

items.text: Could you switch on **a light**? There isn't enough **light** to read.
Is there **room** for one more person in your car?
The year in Seoul was **an amazing experience**, and it gave me useful **experience** in sales.
items.translation: Seulda o'tgan yil **unutilmas taassurot** bo'ldi va menga savdo sohasida foydali **tajriba** berdi.

blocks.text: Ichimlik va ovqat: coffee — a coffee, cheese — a fine cheese

Ichimliklar (coffee, tea, juice, water) modda sifatida sanalmaydi: I drink a lot of **coffee**. Lekin kafeda buyurtma berganda bir porsiya sanaladi: **Two coffees** and **an orange juice**, please. Yana bir nozik ma'no — **nav, tur**: sanalmaydigan ot «bir turi» ma'nosida **a / an** va ko'plik oladi: This is **a** very good **cheese** — Bu juda yaxshi pishloq (navi). The shop sells **teas** from all over the world — Do'kon dunyoning turli joylaridan choy navlarini sotadi. **fruit** odatda sanalmaydi (Eat more **fruit**), **fruits** esa meva turlari haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

items.text: Can we have **two teas** and **a hot chocolate**, please?
items.translation: Bizga **ikkita choy** va **bitta issiq shokolad** bering, iltimos.

items.text: Dilnoza doesn't drink **coffee** after six because it keeps her awake.
items.translation: Dilnoza soat oltidan keyin **qahva** ichmaydi, chunki keyin uxlay olmaydi.

items.text: This shop sells over fifty **teas** from China, India and Sri Lanka.
items.translation: Bu do'kon Xitoy, Hindiston va Shri-Lankadan keltirilgan ellikdan ortiq **choy navini** sotadi.

blocks.text: Mavhum ot + sifat: education — a good education

Mavhum otlar (education, knowledge, love, fear, interest, life) umumiy ma'noda sanalmaydi: **Education** is free in many countries. Lekin sifat yoki aniqlovchi bilan **bitta turini, bitta holatini** bildirsa, ko'pincha **a / an** oladi: She got **an excellent education** in Oxford. He has **a good knowledge of** Arabic. I have **a fear of** heights. Mantiq o'sha-o'sha: **a** — «ko'p turlardan biri». Lekin bu qoida hamma mavhum otga ham to'g'ri kelavermaydi: «a good weather», «a useful advice» — xato (→ 70-dars).

items.text: My grandfather never got **a proper education**, but he reads a lot.
items.translation: Bobom hech qachon **to'liq ta'lim** olmagan, lekin ko'p kitob o'qiydi.

items.text: Kate has **a deep knowledge of** Central Asian history.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I don't have a time» → **I don't have time** (vaqt sanalmaydi); «many money», «many time» → **a lot of money**, **a lot of time**; «less mistakes» → **fewer mistakes**; «She has beautiful hairs» → **She has beautiful hair** (bitta tola — **a hair**); «I have five years experiences» → **five years' experience**; «Put a paper in the printer» → **Put some paper** in the printer (**a paper** — gazeta yoki maqola); «There is no place for my bag» (joy yetmaydi ma'nosida) → **There's no room** for my bag.

Bo'lish testi: narsani bo'laklarga bo'lib ko'ring. Bo'lagi ham o'sha nom bilan ataladimi (bir qoshiq asal — hamon asal) → sanalmaydi. Bo'lak endi o'sha narsa emasmi (yarim kompyuter — kompyuter emas) → sanaladi. Ikki ma'noli so'zda esa o'zingizdan so'rang: «bitta dona yoki hodisa» haqida gapiryapmanmi, yoki «modda, umumiy tushuncha» haqidami?

Bog'liq darslar: o'zbekchada sanaladigan, inglizchada sanalmaydigan otlar (advice, information, news, furniture) — 70-dars; **a / an** va **some** tanlovi — 71-dars; **much / many / little / few** — 87-dars.

rows: **a light** / light, **a room** / room, **an experience** / experience

examples.title: Countable: **a** designer, two **developers**
examples.description: Sanaladigan otlar: birlikda **a / an** (yoki the, my), ko'plikda `-s`, son, many va several bilan. Ish va o'qish mavzusida.

sentences.text: Our team has hired **a new designer** and **two developers** this month.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz bu oy **bitta yangi dizayner** va **ikkita dasturchi** ishga oldi.

sentences.text: I sent **an email** to the manager, but she hasn't replied yet.
sentences.translation: Menejerga **elektron xat** yubordim, lekin u hali javob bermadi.

sentences.text: How **many applications** did you send before you got this job?
sentences.translation: Bu ishga kirgunga qadar **nechta ariza** yuborgan edingiz?

sentences.text: Bekzod is writing **a report** on **three projects** that failed last year.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'tgan yili muvaffaqiyatsiz chiqqan **uchta loyiha** bo'yicha **hisobot** yozyapti.

sentences.text: There are **several mistakes** in this contract, so please check it again.
sentences.translation: Bu shartnomada **bir nechta xato** bor, iltimos, yana bir tekshirib chiqing.

sentences.text: Sarah has **a cousin** in Edinburgh and **two aunts** in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Saraning Edinburgda **bitta amakivachchasi**, Manchesterda esa **ikkita xolasi** bor.

sentences.text: Every student needs **a laptop** for this course, so the university lends them out.
sentences.translation: Bu kursda har bir talabaga **noutbuk** kerak, shuning uchun universitet ularni vaqtincha berib turadi.

sentences.text: We visited **four museums** in two days, and my feet still hurt!
sentences.translation: Ikki kunda **to'rtta muzeyni** aylandik, oyoqlarim hali ham og'riyapti!

sentences.text: Can you recommend **a good dentist** somewhere near the city centre?
sentences.translation: Shahar markazi atrofida **yaxshi tish shifokori** tavsiya qila olasizmi?

sentences.text: Only **a few people** came to the meeting, although we had sent **forty invitations**.
sentences.translation: **Qirqta taklifnoma** yuborgan bo'lsak ham, yig'ilishga **bir necha kishigina** keldi.

examples.title: Uncountable: **electricity**, **pollution**, **patience**
examples.description: Sanalmaydigan otlar — modda va mavhum tushunchalar: **a / an** yo'q, `-s` yo'q, fe'l birlikda (is, was, has).

sentences.text: **Electricity** is very expensive this winter, so we're using the heater less.
sentences.translation: Bu qish **elektr** juda qimmat, shuning uchun isitgichni kamroq yoqyapmiz.

sentences.text: **Air pollution** in big cities is a serious problem for children's health.
sentences.translation: Katta shaharlardagi **havo ifloslanishi** bolalar sog'lig'i uchun jiddiy muammo.

sentences.text: Teaching small children requires a lot of **patience** and energy.
sentences.translation: Kichik bolalarga dars berish ko'p **sabr** va kuch talab qiladi.

sentences.text: Is there any **petrol** in the car, or do we need to stop on the way?
sentences.translation: Mashinada **benzin** bormi yoki yo'lda to'xtashimiz kerakmi?

sentences.text: The **sand** on this beach is so hot that you can't walk barefoot.
sentences.translation: Bu plyajdagi **qum** shunchalik issiqki, yalangoyoq yurib bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: My grandmother puts **honey** in her tea instead of **sugar**.
sentences.translation: Buvim choyiga **shakar** o'rniga **asal** soladi.

sentences.text: **Unemployment** has fallen in the region thanks to the new factories.
sentences.translation: Yangi zavodlar tufayli viloyatda **ishsizlik** kamaydi.

sentences.text: Without **oxygen**, the human brain can survive for only a few minutes.
sentences.translation: **Kislorodsiz** inson miyasi bor-yo'g'i bir necha daqiqa yashay oladi.

sentences.text: James has plenty of **courage**, but sometimes he lacks **common sense**.
sentences.translation: Jeymsda **jasorat** yetarli, lekin ba'zan unga **sog'lom fikr** yetishmaydi.

sentences.text: **Safety** is more important than speed, so all the workers wear helmets.
sentences.translation: **Xavfsizlik** tezlikdan muhimroq, shuning uchun barcha ishchilar kaska kiyadi.

examples.title: **much** / **many**, **less** / **fewer**, **a number of**
examples.description: Miqdor so'zi ot turiga bog'liq: sanaladigan ko'plik bilan many, few, fewer, a number of; sanalmaydigan bilan much, little, less, an amount of.

sentences.text: We don't have **much time**, so let's discuss only the main points.
sentences.translation: **Vaqtimiz ko'p emas**, shuning uchun faqat asosiy masalalarni muhokama qilaylik.

sentences.text: How **many languages** does your sister speak? — Four, including Korean.
sentences.translation: Opangiz **nechta tilda** gaplashadi? — To'rtta, koreys tilini ham qo'shib.

sentences.text: **Fewer students** chose physics this year, which worries the teachers.
sentences.translation: Bu yil fizikani **kamroq talaba** tanladi, bu o'qituvchilarni xavotirga solyapti.

sentences.text: Our new car uses **less fuel** than the old one did.
sentences.translation: Yangi mashinamiz eskisiga qaraganda **kamroq yoqilg'i** sarflaydi.

sentences.text: There's **very little milk** left — could you buy some on the way home?
sentences.translation: **Sut juda oz** qoldi — uyga qaytayotib olib kela olasanmi?

sentences.text: Only **a few friends** know that I'm moving to London next month.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy Londonga ko'chib ketayotganimni **bir nechta do'stimgina** biladi.

sentences.text: **A large number of** tourists visit Khiva every spring.
sentences.translation: Har bahorda Xivaga **juda ko'p** sayyoh keladi.

sentences.text: The project required **a huge amount of** money and effort.
sentences.translation: Loyiha **juda katta miqdorda** pul va kuch talab qildi.

sentences.text: How **much sleep** do you usually get before an important exam?
sentences.translation: Muhim imtihon oldidan odatda **qancha uxlaysiz**?

sentences.text: If you want **fewer arguments** at home, spend **less money** on gadgets.
sentences.translation: Uyda **janjal kamroq** bo'lishini istasangiz, gadjetlarga **kamroq pul** sarflang.

examples.title: Two meanings: **a light** / **light**, **a paper** / **paper**
examples.description: Bitta so'z — ikki ma'no: sanaladigan shakl alohida narsa yoki hodisani, sanalmaydigan shakl modda yoki umumiy tushunchani bildiradi.

sentences.text: **A light** was still on in Aziz's office when I left at ten.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda chiqib ketayotganimda Azizning ofisida hali **chiroq** yonib turgan edi.

sentences.text: Plants need **light** and water, so keep them near the window.
sentences.translation: O'simliklarga **yorug'lik** va suv kerak, shuning uchun ularni deraza yonida saqlang.

sentences.text: Did you hear **a noise**? I think someone is in the garden.
sentences.translation: **Tovush** eshitdingmi? Menimcha, bog'da kimdir bor.

sentences.text: **Noise** from the motorway keeps us awake at night.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistraldan keladigan **shovqin** kechasi uxlashga qo'ymaydi.

sentences.text: I buy **a paper** every morning to read on the train.
sentences.translation: Har tong poyezdda o'qish uchun **gazeta** sotib olaman.

sentences.text: Could you put some **paper** in the printer? It's empty again.
sentences.translation: Printerga **qog'oz** solib qo'ya olasizmi? Yana tugab qolibdi.

sentences.text: Dr Wilson presented **a paper** on climate change at the conference in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Doktor Uilson Oksforddagi konferensiyada iqlim o'zgarishi haqida **ilmiy maqola** bilan chiqdi.

sentences.text: There's **a hair** in my soup! — I'm so sorry, I'll bring you another bowl.
sentences.translation: Sho'rvamda **soch** bor! — Juda uzr, sizga boshqa kosa olib kelaman.

sentences.text: Madina has long dark **hair**, so you'll recognise her easily.
sentences.translation: Madinaning **sochi** uzun va qora, uni oson taniysiz.

sentences.text: My uncle runs **a small business**, but he says **business** is slow this year.
sentences.translation: Amakimning **kichik firmasi** bor, lekin uning aytishicha, bu yil **savdo-sotiq** sust.

examples.title: **a room** / **room**, **a time** / **time**, **an experience**
examples.description: Yana ikki ma'noli otlar: a room (xona) — room (bo'sh joy), a time (marta, davr) — time (vaqt), an experience (voqea, taassurot) — experience (tajriba).

sentences.text: We booked **a room** with a view of the Registan.
sentences.translation: Registonga qaraydigan **xona** band qildik.

sentences.text: Is there **room** in your suitcase for my jacket?
sentences.translation: Chamadoningda kurtkamga **joy** bormi?

sentences.text: Sorry, there isn't enough **room** for a piano in this flat.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu kvartirada pianino uchun **joy** yetarli emas.

sentences.text: I've been to Bukhara **three times**, and I'd happily go again tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **uch marta** bo'lganman, ertaga ham bajonidil yana borardim.

sentences.text: Did you have **a good time** at the wedding? — Yes, it was wonderful.
sentences.translation: To'yda **maza qildingmi**? — Ha, ajoyib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Hurry up — we haven't got much **time** before the train leaves.
sentences.translation: Shoshil — poyezd jo'nashiga **vaqt** ko'p qolmadi.

sentences.text: The pandemic was **a difficult time** for small cafés and shops.
sentences.translation: Pandemiya kichik kafe va do'konlar uchun **og'ir davr** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Do you have any **experience** of working with young children?
sentences.translation: Kichik bolalar bilan ishlash bo'yicha **tajribangiz** bormi?

sentences.text: Climbing Big Chimgan in winter was **an experience** I'll never forget.
sentences.translation: Qishda Katta Chimyonga chiqish hech qachon unutmaydigan **taassurotim** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Kate got the job because she had **more experience** than the other candidates, although she was younger.
sentences.translation: Keyt boshqa nomzodlardan yoshroq bo'lsa ham, **tajribasi ko'proq** bo'lgani uchun ishga olindi.

examples.title: Drinks and kinds: **a coffee**, **two teas**, **a cheese**
examples.description: Ichimlik modda sifatida sanalmaydi, lekin buyurtmada bir porsiya sanaladi (a coffee). Sanalmaydigan ot «nav, tur» ma'nosida ham a / an va ko'plik oladi.

sentences.text: I drink far too much **coffee** when I'm working to a deadline.
sentences.translation: Muddati yaqin ish ustida o'tirganimda haddan tashqari ko'p **qahva** ichaman.

sentences.text: Can I have **a coffee** with milk and **a glass of water**, please?
sentences.translation: Menga sutli **bitta qahva** va **bir stakan suv** bering, iltimos.

sentences.text: We ordered **two teas** and **an orange juice** while we waited for Tom.
sentences.translation: Tomni kutib o'tirganimizda **ikkita choy** va **bitta apelsin sharbati** buyurtma qildik.

sentences.text: Fresh **juice** is healthier than the sweet drinks that children usually buy.
sentences.translation: Yangi siqilgan **sharbat** bolalar odatda sotib oladigan shirin ichimliklardan foydaliroq.

sentences.text: This is **an excellent cheese** — where did you buy it?
sentences.translation: Bu **ajoyib pishloq** ekan — qayerdan oldingiz?

sentences.text: This bakery makes **five different breads**, but the Samarkand one sells best.
sentences.translation: Bu novvoyxona **besh xil non** yopadi, lekin eng xaridorgiri — Samarqand noni.

sentences.text: Green and black **teas** come from the same plant, believe it or not.
sentences.translation: Ishonasizmi-yo'qmi, ko'k va qora **choy** bitta o'simlikdan olinadi.

sentences.text: Doctors say we should eat more **fruit** and fewer sweets.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar **mevani** ko'proq, shirinliklarni esa kamroq yeyish kerakligini aytishadi.

sentences.text: **Tropical fruits** such as mango and papaya are still expensive in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda mango va papayya kabi **tropik mevalar** hali ham qimmat.

sentences.text: Would you like **a tea** or **a coffee**? — Neither, thanks, I've just had **some juice**.
sentences.translation: **Choy** yoki **qahva** ichasizmi? — Rahmat, kerak emas, hozirgina **sharbat** ichdim.

examples.title: Abstract nouns: **education** / **a good education**
examples.description: Mavhum ot umumiy ma'noda sanalmaydi, lekin sifat yoki aniqlovchi bilan bitta turini bildirsa — a / an oladi: a good education, a fear of flying.

sentences.text: **Education** is free at state schools in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistondagi davlat maktablarida **ta'lim** bepul.

sentences.text: Their parents worked hard to give them **a good education**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalari ularga **yaxshi ta'lim** berish uchun ko'p mehnat qilishgan.

sentences.text: Jasur has **a fear of flying**, so he always takes the train.
sentences.translation: Jasur **samolyotda uchishdan qo'rqadi**, shuning uchun doim poyezdda yuradi.

sentences.text: **Fear** can stop people from trying new things.
sentences.translation: **Qo'rquv** odamni yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishdan to'xtatib qo'yishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Emma has **a good knowledge of** Uzbek history, which surprised our guide.
sentences.translation: Emma O'zbekiston tarixini **yaxshi biladi**, bu gidimizni hayron qoldirdi.

sentences.text: In this job, **knowledge** of two foreign languages is essential.
sentences.translation: Bu ishda ikki chet tilini **bilish** shart.

sentences.text: My brother has **a real love of** nature, so he became a park ranger.
sentences.translation: Akam tabiatni **chin dildan sevadi**, shuning uchun qo'riqxona xodimi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Grandpa lived **a long and happy life** in a small village near Fergana.
sentences.translation: Bobom Farg'ona yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda **uzoq va baxtli umr** ko'rdi.

sentences.text: There's **a growing interest** in electric cars among young drivers.
sentences.translation: Yosh haydovchilar orasida elektromobillarga **qiziqish ortib boryapti**.

sentences.text: We need someone with **a sense of humour** and **patience** for this position, not just a CV full of diplomas.
sentences.translation: Bu lavozimga diplomlarga to'la rezyume emas, **hazil tuyg'usi** va **sabr-toqati** bor odam kerak.

examples.title: Mixed: countable or uncountable?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ot turi artiklni, ko'plikni va miqdor so'zini qanday belgilashi — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: We had **a great time** in Edinburgh, but there wasn't enough **time** to see everything.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **zo'r dam oldik**, lekin hammasini ko'rishga **vaqt** yetmadi.

sentences.text: The flat has **three rooms**, but there's hardly any **room** for a desk.
sentences.translation: Kvartirada **uchta xona** bor, lekin stol qo'yishga deyarli **joy** yo'q.

sentences.text: Nilufar has three years' **experience** in marketing, so the agency offered her **a job** immediately.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning marketing sohasida uch yillik **tajribasi** bor, shuning uchun agentlik unga darhol **ish** taklif qildi.

sentences.text: How **many cups of coffee** do you drink a day? — Too **many**, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Kuniga **necha piyola qahva** ichasiz? — Afsuski, **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: The **noise** from the building site gave me **a terrible headache**.
sentences.translation: Qurilishdan kelayotgan **shovqin** tufayli **boshim qattiq og'rib qoldi**.

sentences.text: **Fewer tourists** came this summer, so the hotels made **less money** than usual.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz **kamroq sayyoh** keldi, shuning uchun mehmonxonalar odatdagidan **kamroq pul** ishladi.

sentences.text: Oliver switched off **the lights** to save **electricity** while everyone was out.
sentences.translation: Hamma tashqarida bo'lganida Oliver **elektrni** tejash uchun **chiroqlarni** o'chirib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Do you sell **paper** for drawing, or only **papers** and magazines?
sentences.translation: Rasm chizish uchun **qog'oz** sotasizmi yoki faqat **gazeta** va jurnallarmi?

sentences.text: After the operation, my father needs **rest** and **a healthy diet**.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin otamga **dam olish** va **sog'lom parhez** kerak.

sentences.text: If you want **a well-paid job** in IT, you need both **knowledge** and **a lot of practice**.
sentences.translation: IT sohasida **yaxshi maoshli ish** topmoqchi bo'lsangiz, sizga ham **bilim**, ham **ko'p amaliyot** kerak.
